_comment: Words struck from the N5 Countdown's vocabulary layer by hand.
This is a DECISION LOG, not a filter constant, and it is separate from
build_vocab.py for the same reason data/sentences/decisions/ is separate
from data/sentences/queue/: refreshing the dictionary must never destroy a
human judgement. A word struck out because its only gloss is 'second
week's memorial services' stays struck through the next JMdict release.
Striking a word is SELECTION. Nothing here edits Japanese, and nothing
here adds any. Every word that survives is still verbatim JMdict with its
entry sequence attached — which is also what keeps the licence position
intact, since CC BY-SA 4.0's ShareAlike triggers on modification, and
choosing not to reprint an entry is not modifying it.
Each entry is [word, reason]. The rules in build_vocab.py catch the
systematic failures; these are the residue that only reads as wrong to
someone who knows what a beginner should meet.

_reasons.funerary: Buddhist memorial-service vocabulary. Correct Japanese, wrong first encounter.
_reasons.almanac: Lunar-calendar or almanac term a native speaker rarely uses.
_reasons.newspaper: Ranked by newspaper frequency, not learner frequency. Financial or政治 register.
_reasons.redundant: Teaches nothing the sheet's other words do not already show.
_reasons.register: Rude, archaic or otherwise wrong to hand a beginner unexplained.
_reasons.derived: A derived form displacing the base word a learner needs first.

_rationale.二七日 / 七七日: funerary — 'second week's memorial services', '49th day after death'. Both carry JMdict newspaper priority tags because a newspaper prints dates.
_rationale.二百十日: almanac — the 210th day from the start of spring in the lunar calendar. Led the sheet for 百.
_rationale.十六日 … 十九日: redundant — the sheet already shows 六日, 八日, 九日. A larger date compound adds a digit, not a character.
_rationale.九九: specialist — the multiplication table. A real word, and not what 九 is for.
_rationale.円み: derived — 'roundness'. 円 is taught as yen and circle; 円い covers the shape.
_rationale.午: register — JMdict's 午 alone is the zodiac Horse. 午前 and 午後 are the words.
_rationale.円高 / 白書 / 大半: newspaper — yen appreciation, government white paper, the majority. All three led their sheets before the ichi1-over-nfXX rule; these are what survived it.
_rationale.山川 / 日食 / 月食 / 見聞: specialist — and 日食 displaced 食べる on the sheet for 食.
_rationale.生る: register — 'to bear fruit', an archaic reading of 生 that competes with 生きる and 生まれる.
_rationale.聞かす / 見出し / 下り / 上り / 年をとる: derived — causatives, headline nouns and train-direction nouns standing where 聞く, 見る and the plain forms belong.
_rationale.毎 / 毎に: register — 毎 is a bound morpheme in practice; 毎日 and 毎年 are the words.
_rationale.お前: register — a rude second person. Not a word to hand a learner with no note attached, and this book carries no notes.
_rationale.気まま: register — 'willful, self-indulgent'. 気 wants 電気 and 人気.
_rationale.一行: specialist — 'a party (of travellers)', not the 一行 = one line a learner would guess.
_rationale.一つ一つ: redundant — a reduplication that occupies a slot 一つ should hold.
_rationale.小火: specialist — ぼや, a small fire, an irregular reading with no general use.
_rationale.食う: register — coarse 'to eat' sitting next to 食べる.

_preferred_note: Words a person insisted on, applied before the ranker. Same durability contract as `rejected`: a JMdict refresh must not undo a human decision. A word listed here that no longer exists in the dictionary is silently skipped rather than faked.
